answer_1.quote: We formulate two main tasks next response prediction and image retrieval. (1) Next response prediction is to predict the next utterance at turn t+1 given the dialogue history ({u_j}_{t-1}^1) and image i_t.
answer_1.outputs: Generated next utterance (text response) and retrieved image

answer_2.quote: We set the number of retrieval candidates to 100 and use Recall@{1,5,10} and mean reciprocal rank (MRR) for the evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: Each human rates 250 randomly chosen samples using a 4-point Likert scale for all criteria... We also conduct head-to-head human evaluations by comparing DialogCC with MMDD, PhotoChat, and MMDialog, evaluating them based on six criteria: (1) natural flow, (2) engagingness, (3) turn relevance, (4) context consistency, (5) diversity, (6) overall.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators evaluate generated outputs according to specified Likert‑scale criteria (e.g., turn relevance, rationale relevance, image relevance) and rank dialogues on dimensions such as natural flow, engagingness, diversity, and overall quality.
